column1: # Query -> the unit that answers it, against an rq checkout — part of the
# first Rust SEARCH ground truth; see tests/eval/rust/trekr/queries.tsv for
# DRAFTED BY CLAUDE, NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE OWNER. Behaviour verified by
merge hits from two indexes under one limit
# --- no token shared with the answer's identifier ----------------------------
# TEST-TRAP: search/mod.rs's own test is named
# identical_names_rank_in_a_stable_order; the ranked search it exercises is
rank the definition the user meant above other symbols
# --- behaviour that appears in NO identifier ---------------------------------
# Damerau's insight in the body: an adjacent-character swap counts as ONE
# edit, because that is what a typo is.
count a swap of two adjacent letters as a single edit
